cards.text: One day Ruth's mother-in-law, Naomi, opens with "My daughter," and friend, when a talk starts like that, you put the dough DOWN. Naomi's got something on her mind for Ruth.

cards.question: Naomi says she wants to seek something for Ruth, so that it may be well with her. What is it?

cards.text: Then Naomi brings up Boaz, the man whose servant girls Ruth has been working with. And Naomi isn't just bringing him up. She knows his SCHEDULE.

cards.question: Naomi reminds Ruth that Boaz is a ___ of theirs.
Naomi knows where Boaz will be tonight, winnowing barley. Where is he?

cards.text: Now Naomi walks Ruth through tonight, step by step. Friend, Naomi has a PLAN, and I can't even plan which oven to open first.

cards.question: Naomi tells Ruth to head to the threshing floor just as she is, in her work clothes.

cards.text: Wash, perfume, best clothes. Me? I've worn this same apron since the day I got here, and I call THAT dressing up.

cards.question: Naomi says the timing matters. When can Ruth let Boaz know she's there?

answers.text: After he finishes eating and drinking
As soon as she gets there

cards.text: Then Naomi gets to the part for after Boaz lies down: Ruth notes the spot, goes in, uncovers his feet and lies down. Friend, I've seen recipe cards with fewer steps than this plan.

cards.question: Naomi says Boaz will explain to Ruth what she should do.
How does Ruth answer Naomi's plan?

answers.text: I will do everything you say
Let me think it over first

cards.text: So Ruth goes down to the threshing floor and does everything Naomi told her. Boaz finishes eating and drinking, he's in good spirits, and he lies down at the end of the heap of grain.

cards.question: Ruth marches in and announces herself to Boaz.

cards.text: At midnight, Boaz is startled, turns over, and there's a woman lying at his feet! Friend, I'd have jumped so high, me AND my gold base would've hit the ceiling.

cards.question: Boaz asks who she is, and Ruth tells him. Then what does Ruth ask Boaz to do?

answers.text: Spread the corner of his garment over her
Walk her home to Naomi at first light
Speak to the elders of the town for her

cards.question: Ruth asks Boaz to spread the corner of his garment over her. What reason does she give?

answers.text: He is a man of the LORD

cards.text: When somebody startles ME, friend, I come up swinging a whisk. But Boaz, startled at midnight, answers Ruth with, "May the LORD bless you, my daughter."

cards.question: Boaz tells Ruth she has shown more kindness now than before.
Boaz says Ruth has not run after the ___ men, whether rich or poor.

cards.text: Then Boaz tells Ruth not to be afraid. He'll do for her WHATEVER she asks, and friend, I can't even get my oven to do what I ask.

cards.question: Boaz says all his fellow townspeople know Ruth is a woman of noble ___.

cards.text: Then Boaz says, "Yes, it is true that I am a kinsman-redeemer, but…" Oh no, friend. There is a BUT.

cards.question: Boaz says no redeemer is nearer to Ruth than he is.

cards.text: So Boaz lays out the plan: Ruth stays tonight, and in the morning, if the nearer redeemer wants to redeem her, good, let him. Friend, it's like getting to the front of the line and hearing, "Hold on, this person was here first."

cards.question: And if the nearer redeemer doesn't want to? What does Boaz promise, as surely as the LORD lives?

answers.text: He will send her back to Moab

cards.text: So Ruth lies at his feet until morning, and she's up before anyone else could recognize her. That's earlier than ME, friend, and my first batch goes in before the stars go out.

cards.question: Boaz wants word to get around that a woman came to the threshing floor.

cards.text: Then Boaz tells Ruth to bring the shawl she's wearing and hold it out. He's packing that shawl like I pack a cookie box, except when I pack one, my mustache ends up with more chocolate chips than the BOX.

cards.question: Boaz pours ___ measures of barley into Ruth's shawl and places it on her.

cards.text: Boaz heads into the city. Ruth heads home and tells Naomi everything Boaz did for her.

cards.question: What does Ruth say Boaz told her when he gave her the barley?

answers.text: Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed
Come back and glean in my field again tomorrow
Share this grain with the servant girls tomorrow

cards.question: Naomi tells Ruth to wait until she finds out how things go. Why?

answers.text: Boaz will not rest until it is settled today
The nearer redeemer is away from town
Boaz needs some time to think it over

cards.text: And that's where Naomi leaves it, friend. I spent years waiting in a junk drawer, so believe me when I tell you this story is NOT done.

findings.problem: This is a where question, but the wrong answer "In his house in town" invents a location for Boaz rather than using a real detail from somewhere in the Bible.

rule.text: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.

findings.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards lets the baker reason out the number six. The blank simply asks for an unseen number from the verse rather than testing meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
